What to Download (Record Set): Account authorization state: Users, Groups, Roles, Managed Policies, Inline Policies
How to Download: CLI: aws iam get-account-authorization-details --output json OR AWS SDK (Boto3: iam.get_account_authorization_details())
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: policy_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, policy_name VARCHAR(128), entity_type VARCHAR(32), entity_name VARCHAR(128), is_attached BOOLEAN, document_json JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMP
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Identify customer-managed policies with wildcard permissions ('Resource: *' with 'Action: *') or admin rights assigned directly to users instead of groups.
MITRE ATT&CK Mapping: T1078 (Valid Accounts), T1098 (Account Manipulation), T1484 (Domain Policy Modification)
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-IAM (Identity & Access Management), D3-POA (Policy Access Control)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: get-account-authorization-details is paginated if response > 1MB. Requires 'iam:GetAccountAuthorizationDetails' permission.

What to Download (Record Set): Security Group IDs, VPC IDs, Ingress Rules (IPPermissions), Egress Rules (IPPermissionsEgress), Tags
How to Download: CLI: aws ec2 describe-security-groups --output json OR AWS SDK (ec2.describe_security_groups())
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: group_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, vpc_id VARCHAR(64), group_name VARCHAR(128), direction VARCHAR(8), protocol VARCHAR(16), from_port INT, to_port INT, cidr_ipv4 VARCHAR(32), cidr_ipv6 VARCHAR(64), rule_json JSONB
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Check for rules allowing unrestricted ingress ('0.0.0.0/0' or '::/0') on administrative ports like TCP/22 (SSH) and TCP/3389 (RDP).
MITRE ATT&CK Mapping: T1190 (Exploit Public-Facing Application), T1021 (Remote Services - SSH/RDP)
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-NI (Network Ingress Filtering), D3-FBR (Firewall Rule Analysis)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Requires 'ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups' and 'ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls' across all active AWS regions.

What to Download (Record Set): Trail ARN, Name, S3BucketName, IsMultiRegionTrail, LogFileValidationEnabled, KmsKeyId, HomeRegion, IsLogging
How to Download: CLI: aws cloudtrail describe-trails --output json && aws cloudtrail get-trail-status --name <trail>
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: trail_arn VARCHAR(256) PRIMARY KEY, trail_name VARCHAR(128), s3_bucket VARCHAR(128), is_multi_region BOOLEAN, log_validation_enabled BOOLEAN, kms_key_id VARCHAR(256), is_logging BOOLEAN, config_json JSONB
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Verify that at least one multi-region trail is configured, active, and logs are write-protected (Log File Validation enabled).
MITRE ATT&CK Mapping: T1562.001 (Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools)
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-AL (Auditing and Logging), D3-LVA (Log Validation)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Only reports trail metadata, not log events. Combine with CloudTrail Event History or Athena for deep telemetry audit.

What to Download (Record Set): Role Assignment ID, PrincipalId, PrincipalType, RoleDefinitionId, RoleDefinitionName, Scope, SubscriptionId
How to Download: CLI: az role assignment list --all --output json OR Azure Resource Graph / REST API GET /subscriptions/{subId}/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: assignment_id VARCHAR(256) PRIMARY KEY, principal_id VARCHAR(64), principal_type VARCHAR(32), principal_name VARCHAR(128), role_name VARCHAR(128), scope VARCHAR(512), subscription_id VARCHAR(64), is_guest BOOLEAN
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Identify guest or unmanaged accounts containing Owner or Contributor roles directly assigned at subscription scopes.
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-IAM (Identity & Access Management), D3-POA (Policy Access Control)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Requires 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/read' across subscriptions. Guest users require cross-referencing with Entra ID user object state.

Details to Extract: Network Security Group (NSG) Rules & Peering Configs
What to Download (Record Set): NSG ID, Name, ResourceGroup, SubnetBindings, SecurityRules (Access, Direction, Priority, SourceAddressPrefix, DestinationPortRange, Protocol), VNet Peerings
How to Download: CLI: az graph query -q "Resources | where type =~ 'Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups'" OR REST API GET /providers/Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: rule_id VARCHAR(256) PRIMARY KEY, nsg_id VARCHAR(256), nsg_name VARCHAR(128), priority INT, direction VARCHAR(16), access VARCHAR(16), source_prefix VARCHAR(64), dest_port_range VARCHAR(64), protocol VARCHAR(16), raw_rule JSONB
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Identify NSGs allowing open ingress on administration ports, and check for unencrypted cross-subscription VNET peerings.
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-NI (Network Ingress Filtering), D3-FBR (Firewall Rule Analysis)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Resource Graph API is subject to query throttling. NetworkWatcher data recommended for live flow monitoring.

What to Download (Record Set): Setting ID, ResourceId, WorkspaceId, StorageAccountId, EventHubName, Logs (Category, Enabled, RetentionPolicy)
How to Download: CLI: az monitor diagnostic-settings list --resource <resource_id> OR az monitor activity-log alert list
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: setting_id VARCHAR(256) PRIMARY KEY, resource_id VARCHAR(512), workspace_id VARCHAR(256), storage_account VARCHAR(256), log_categories JSONB, alerts_enabled BOOLEAN
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Ensure administrative write events (such as resource creation or policy changes) trigger SIEM forwarding and security alerts.
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-AL (Auditing and Logging), D3-SCA (Security Control Auditing)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Must iterate across all Azure resource types or query Azure Resource Graph for comprehensive coverage.

What to Download (Record Set): ETag, Bindings (Role, Members [user:, serviceAccount:, group:, domain:, allUsers]), AuditConfigs
How to Download: CLI: gcloud projects get-iam-policy <project_id> --format=json OR GCP Asset Inventory API (gcloud asset search-all-iam-policies)
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: binding_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, project_id VARCHAR(64), role VARCHAR(128), member_type VARCHAR(32), member_email VARCHAR(128), condition JSONB, policy_etag VARCHAR(64)
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Identify wildcard bindings or external Gmail accounts assigned Editor or Owner roles at the project root.
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-IAM (Identity & Access Management), D3-POA (Policy Access Control)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Direct project query misses inherited folder/organization policies. Asset Inventory API provides unified inheritance view.

What to Download (Record Set): Rule ID, Name, Network, Direction, Priority, SourceRanges, Allowed/Denied Protocols & Ports, Disabled, TargetTags
How to Download: CLI: gcloud compute firewall-rules list --format=json OR Compute Engine REST API GET /projects/{project}/global/firewalls
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: rule_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, project_id VARCHAR(64), rule_name VARCHAR(128), direction VARCHAR(16), action VARCHAR(16), priority INT, source_ranges JSONB, allowed_ports JSONB, is_disabled BOOLEAN
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Check for firewall rules with 'sourceRanges' set to '0.0.0.0/0' combined with port 22 or 3389 open.
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-NI (Network Ingress Filtering), D3-FBR (Firewall Rule Analysis)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Hierarchical firewall policies at organization/folder levels can override VPC rules and must be queried separately.

What to Download (Record Set): Sink Name, Destination (storage.googleapis.com, pubsub.googleapis.com, bigquery.googleapis.com), Filter, WriterIdentity, Disabled
How to Download: CLI: gcloud logging sinks list --format=json OR Cloud Logging API GET /v2/projects/{project}/sinks
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: sink_name VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, project_id VARCHAR(64), destination VARCHAR(256), filter_text TEXT, writer_identity VARCHAR(128), is_disabled BOOLEAN
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Verify project audit logs are actively streamed to a centralized bucket, Pub/Sub, or BigQuery sink for compliance auditing.
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-AL (Auditing and Logging)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Check sink filters to ensure audit logs (cloudaudit.googleapis.com) are not excluded by log exclusion rules.

What to Download (Record Set): Listener stanza (tcp, tls_disable, tls_cert_file, address), Storage stanza (raft, consul, storage_path), disable_mlock, api_addr
How to Download: File Read: /etc/vault.d/vault.hcl OR API GET /v1/sys/health & GET /v1/sys/config/state (Vault Enterprise)
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: config_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, hostname VARCHAR(128), tls_disable BOOLEAN, disable_mlock BOOLEAN, storage_type VARCHAR(32), listener_address VARCHAR(128), config_raw TEXT
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Verify memory locking ('disable_mlock = false') is enabled and TLS listeners are enforced ('tls_disable = 0').
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-MEN (Memory Encryption/Locking), D3-DEC (Data Encryption in Transit)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Direct HCL file read requires root/admin filesystem access on Vault nodes. API alternatives require root/sudo policy.

How to Extract (Command / API / Method): vault policy list && vault policy read <policy_name>
What to Download (Record Set): Policy Name, Rules (Path, Capabilities: create, read, update, delete, list, sudo, deny, Allowed/Denied Parameters)
How to Download: CLI: vault policy list -format=json && vault policy read <name> -format=json OR API GET /v1/sys/policies/acl
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: policy_name VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, path_pattern VARCHAR(256), capabilities JSONB, allowed_parameters JSONB, raw_hcl TEXT
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Scan policy definitions for wildcard write/sudo privileges (e.g. path 'secret/data/*' with capability 'write' or 'sudo').
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-POA (Policy Access Control), D3-IAM (Identity & Access Management)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Requires Vault Token with 'sys/policies/acl' read permissions. Parse HCL into structured paths for automated evaluation.

What to Download (Record Set): Audit Device Path, Type (file, syslog, socket), Description, Options (file_path, prefix, log_raw, format)
How to Download: CLI: vault audit list -format=json OR API GET /v1/sys/audit
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: device_path VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, type VARCHAR(32), description TEXT, options JSONB, is_active BOOLEAN
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Ensure system audit logging is enabled and outputs to secure remote logging endpoints (e.g., Syslog or immutable file).
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-AL (Auditing and Logging)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: If no audit device is enabled, Vault drops all request/response audit trails. Requires 'sys/audit' read privileges.

Details to Extract: Checked-out Privileged Accounts & Active RDP/SSH Sessions
What to Download (Record Set): SessionId, UserID, AccountName, SystemName, Protocol (RDP/SSH), StartTime, MaxCheckoutDuration, TicketNumber, AccessType, Status
How to Download: API: GET /api/v1/active-sessions & GET /api/v1/requests (Auth via OAuth Token / API Key header)
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: session_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, user_id VARCHAR(64), account_name VARCHAR(128), target_system VARCHAR(128), protocol VARCHAR(16), start_time TIMESTAMP, max_duration_mins INT, ticket_number VARCHAR(64), status VARCHAR(32)
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Check for checked-out credentials that have exceeded maximum check-out window or active sessions operating without matching ITSM ticket numbers.
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-PAM (Privileged Access Management), D3-SBM (Session Behavior Monitoring)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Requires REST API User with 'Audit Reader' / 'Session Manager' role in BeyondTrust PasswordSafe / Privileged Remote Access.

What to Download (Record Set): Identity ID, Name, Email, LifecycleState (Active, Terminated), JobTitle, Entitlements (Source, Attribute, Value), CertificationStatus
How to Download: API: GET /v3/public-identities & GET /v3/entitlement-assignments (OAuth2 Bearer Token)
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: identity_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(128), email VARCHAR(128), lifecycle_state VARCHAR(32), title VARCHAR(128), entitlements JSONB, last_certification_date TIMESTAMP
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Identify users retaining administrative roles ('AWS-Admin', 'Domain-Admin') who are marked as terminated in HR databases or have failed entitlement recertifications.
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-IAM (Identity & Access Management), D3-UAR (User Access Recertification)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Requires IdentityNow API Personal Access Token (PAT) with 'idn:identity:read' and 'idn:entitlement:read' scopes.

Details to Extract: User Object Attributes & Domain Group Memberships
What to Download (Record Set): SamAccountName, DistinguishedName, Enabled, PasswordLastSet, PasswordNeverExpires, LastLogonDate, MemberOf (Group DNs), UserAccountControl
How to Download: PowerShell: Get-ADUser -Filter * -Properties MemberOf, PasswordLastSet, PasswordNeverExpires, LastLogonDate, Enabled | ConvertTo-Json OR LDAP Query
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: sam_account_name VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, dn VARCHAR(512), enabled BOOLEAN, password_last_set TIMESTAMP, password_never_expires BOOLEAN, last_logon_date TIMESTAMP, member_of JSONB, uac_flags INT
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Scan for active accounts with 'PasswordNeverExpires = True' or members in privileged groups (e.g., Domain Admins) who are not actively used.
MITRE ATT&CK Mapping: T1078 (Valid Accounts), T1201 (Password Policy Discovery), T1069 (Group Discovery)
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-IAM (Identity & Access Management), D3-PMP (Password Management Policy)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Large AD environments require pagination (-ResultPageSize 1000) or Active Directory PowerShell Module installed on collector host.

What to Download (Record Set): GPO ID, DisplayName, SecurityFiltering, ExtensionData (Registry Settings: LSA Protection, ScriptBlockLogging, PowerShell Transcription, LM Compatibility)
How to Download: PowerShell: Get-GPOReport -All -ReportType Xml -Path C:\gpo_backup\report.xml OR Backup-GPO -All -Path <dir>
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: gpo_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, gpo_name VARCHAR(256), gpo_status VARCHAR(32), lsa_protection_enabled BOOLEAN, ps_transcription_enabled BOOLEAN, ps_scriptblock_logging BOOLEAN, lm_hash_level INT, raw_xml TEXT
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Check for missing GPO configurations, such as missing LSA protection, disabled PowerShell transcriptions, or LM hashing compatibility enabled.
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-SPH (System Policy Hardening), D3-GPO (Group Policy Enforcement)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Requires RSAT GPMC tools installed. XML report must be parsed via XPath or converted to JSON before ingestion.

What to Download (Record Set): AssignmentId, RoleDefinitionId, RoleDisplayName, PrincipalId, PrincipalDisplayName, UserPrincipalName, PrincipalType (User, Guest, ServicePrincipal)
How to Download: API: GET /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments?$expand=principal,roleDefinition (OAuth2 App Registration)
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: assignment_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, role_definition_id VARCHAR(128), role_name VARCHAR(128), principal_id VARCHAR(128), principal_name VARCHAR(128), principal_type VARCHAR(32), is_guest BOOLEAN
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Identify standard users, guest accounts, or service principals assigned critical administrative roles (Global Administrator, User Administrator).
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-IAM (Identity & Access Management), D3-POA (Policy Access Control)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Requires Microsoft Graph App Permission 'RoleManagement.Read.Directory'. Does not include Azure RBAC (sub-level) roles.

What to Download (Record Set): RiskId, UserPrincipalName, RiskState (atRisk, confirmedCompromised, remediated), RiskLevel (low, medium, high), RiskEventType, DetectionTiming, Source
How to Download: API: GET /v1.0/identityProtection/riskDetections OR GET /v1.0/identityProtection/riskyUsers
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: risk_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, user_principal_name VARCHAR(128), risk_state VARCHAR(32), risk_level VARCHAR(16), risk_event_type VARCHAR(128), detection_time TIMESTAMP, source VARCHAR(64)
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Identify user accounts with un-remediated risk levels of Medium or High, suggesting active token hijacking or credential leaks.
MITRE ATT&CK Mapping: T1110 (Brute Force), T1539 (Steal Web Session Cookie), T1078 (Valid Accounts)
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-UEBA (User & Entity Behavior Analytics), D3-ITA (Identity Threat Analysis)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Requires Microsoft Entra ID P2 license and Graph Permission 'IdentityRiskValue.Read.All'.

What to Download (Record Set): AlertId, Title, Severity (Informational, Low, Medium, High), Category, Status (New, InProgress, Resolved), Evidence (UserAccount, Computer, IPAddress), MitreTechniques
How to Download: API: GET /v1.0/security/alerts?$filter=vendorInformation/provider eq 'Defender for Identity' OR MS Defender XDR API
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: alert_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(256), severity VARCHAR(16), category VARCHAR(64), status VARCHAR(32), impacted_user VARCHAR(128), impacted_computer VARCHAR(128), mitre_techniques JSONB
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Verify all Active Directory-level threat detections (e.g. Kerberoasting, Golden Ticket, DCSync) are actively reviewed and marked as closed.
MITRE ATT&CK Mapping: T1558 (Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets), T1003.006 (DCSync)
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-ANOM (Anomaly Detection), D3-ITA (Identity Threat Analysis)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Requires MDI Sensor deployment on Domain Controllers and Graph Permission 'SecurityAlert.Read.All'.

What to Download (Record Set): IssueId, Title, Severity (HIGH, CRITICAL), Status (OPEN, RESOLVED), EntityId, EntityName, EntityType, Categories (Exposed Secret + Public IP)
How to Download: GraphQL API Query: POST https://api.wiz.io/graphql with OAuth2 bearer token obtained from https://auth.wiz.io/oauth/token
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: issue_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(256), severity VARCHAR(16), status VARCHAR(32), entity_id VARCHAR(128), entity_name VARCHAR(128), entity_type VARCHAR(64), toxic_combination_tags JSONB
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Verify there are zero open high/critical issues, specifically looking for VMs containing exposed secrets and public network routes.
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-CHA (Cloud Hygiene Assessment), D3-CVA (Configuration Vulnerability Assessment)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Requires Wiz Client ID & Client Secret with read access to Issues and Cloud Graph.

How to Extract (Command / API / Method): CIS-CAT tool runs or custom JSON checklist reports
What to Download (Record Set): BenchmarkID, Version, TargetHost, RuleID, RuleTitle, Result (PASS, FAIL, ERROR, NOT_CHECKED), ImpactScore, Rationale
How to Download: CLI: cis-cat-full.sh / cis-cat.bat -r <out_dir> OR OpenSCAP: oscap xccdf eval --report report.html
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: report_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, host_id VARCHAR(128), benchmark_name VARCHAR(128), rule_id VARCHAR(128), rule_title VARCHAR(256), result VARCHAR(16), impact_score INT, failed_reason TEXT
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Identify host and network platforms where system configuration drifts from established hardening frameworks (CIS Benchmarks).
MITRE ATT&CK Mapping: M1047 (Audit), M1028 (Operating System Hardening), M1026 (Privileged Account Management)
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-SPH (System Policy Hardening), D3-SCA (Security Control Auditing)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: CIS-CAT Pro requires active CIS membership / license. OpenSCAP is open-source alternative for RHEL/Linux.

How to Extract (Command / API / Method): Windows Event Log ID 4688 / Sysmon Event ID 1
What to Download (Record Set): EventID, TimeCreated, Computer, ProcessId, NewProcessName (cmd.exe, powershell.exe), ParentProcessName (winword.exe, w3wp.exe), CommandLine, User
How to Download: PowerShell: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';ID=4688} OR EDR API / Windows Event Forwarding (WEF)
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: event_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, host_name VARCHAR(128), timestamp TIMESTAMP, process_name VARCHAR(256), parent_process VARCHAR(256), command_line TEXT, user_account VARCHAR(128), is_suspicious BOOLEAN
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Scan for instances of cmd.exe or powershell.exe spawned directly by office products (Word, Excel) or web servers (IIS, Apache).
MITRE ATT&CK Mapping: T1059.001 (PowerShell), T1059.003 (Windows Command Shell), T1204 (User Execution)
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-PSA (Process Segment Analysis), D3-PEA (Process Execution Analysis)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Win Event 4688 requires 'Include command line in process creation events' GPO policy enabled. Sysmon provides MD5/SHA256 hashes.

How to Extract (Command / API / Method): Windows Event Log ID 4104 (PowerShell Script Block)
What to Download (Record Set): EventID, TimeCreated, Computer, ScriptBlockId, ScriptBlockText, Path, User, Message, IsEncodedFlag
How to Download: PowerShell: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational';ID=4104} OR SIEM Collector
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: event_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, host_name VARCHAR(128), timestamp TIMESTAMP, script_block_id VARCHAR(128), script_content TEXT, user_account VARCHAR(128), contains_obfuscation BOOLEAN
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Identify commands containing base64 obfuscation ('-enc', '-encodedcommand') or bypassing security execution policies ('bypass').
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-SBA (Script Block Analysis), D3-SAA (Script Analysis & Auditing)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Script Block Logging must be enabled via GPO ('Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging'). De-obfuscation pipeline needed for deep analysis.

How to Extract (Command / API / Method): Windows Event ID 4657 / Sysmon Event ID 13
What to Download (Record Set): EventID, TimeCreated, Computer, ProcessName, TargetObject (Registry Key / LSASS Process Handle), Details, OperationType, User
How to Download: PowerShell: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Security';ID=4657} OR Sysmon log stream via SIEM
RDBMS Schema & Column Types: event_id VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY, host_name VARCHAR(128), timestamp TIMESTAMP, process_name VARCHAR(256), target_object VARCHAR(512), operation_type VARCHAR(32), user_account VARCHAR(128)
Vulnerability / Audit Check Criteria: Monitor attempts by non-system processes to read LSASS process memory or modify logon helper DLL registry keys.
MITRE ATT&CK Mapping: T1003.001 (LSASS Memory), T1547.001 (Registry Run Keys), T1547.005 (Security Support Provider)
MITRE D3FEND Mapping: D3-MMP (Memory Protection), D3-RMA (Registry Modification Analysis)
Tool Limitations & Analysis Notes: Requires SACL auditing enabled on sensitive registry paths (e.g., LSA, Winlogon, Run keys) or Sysmon configuration file deployed.
